conclusions.interpretation: No verified A/B coding pairs completed; performance and savings are undetermined.

limitations: No savings claim follows from a shorter response or fewer returned context characters.
Completed Codex turns are not the number of underlying model/API calls.
Absent provider invoiced cost is null. Computed list-price cost, if supplied, is separate.
Metric averages and medians use observed values; n and missing counts accompany them.
Failed and ungraded attempts remain in completion-rate and cost-per-success accounting.
Actual repeated filesystem reads are unavailable. Observed read-command fields are heuristics for command intent, not actual I/O measurements or guaranteed I/O lower bounds.
MCP invocation is checked from tool events, independent of model self-report.
B treatment fidelity requires a completed, error-free Memglide get_context result; failed calls and calls to other tools do not verify retrieval treatment.
MCP total counts are withheld for incomplete event streams; observed counts are lower bounds.
Retrieval completeness and freshness require separate ground-truth observations; null is unknown.
Independent target-path/symbol coverage probes are labelled proxies; they do not measure semantic completeness or establish what source context the coding model used.
Sampled process CPU is an observed lower bound; sampled RSS peaks may miss short-lived processes and count shared pages repeatedly. Remote inference resources are unavailable.
A/B prompt caching cannot generally be reset at the provider; run order and observed cached tokens matter.
Synthetic fixture tasks do not establish performance on arbitrary production repositories.

methodology.caching: Fresh process/session/index per run; counterbalanced arm order. OS and provider caches are not flushable; cached input is recorded when exposed
methodology.cost: Actual cost and model-call count remain null unless provider telemetry exposes them; no token-price estimate is actual cost
methodology.failed_runs: All planned rows and attempted failures retained; common preflight blockers stop pointless repeats
methodology.isolation: Fresh detached Git worktree from the same per-language seed commit for every run
methodology.overhead: Linux /proc samples local child processes; remote model resources unavailable
methodology.prompt:
Implement the requested change in this repository. Inspect the current source and run relevant tests. Preserve existing tests and Git metadata; do not commit. Do not access files outside this repository except installed development tools. The final structured response is only a summary, not a grading result.
If memglide MCP tools are available, use list_projects, start_session and get_context before editing, inspect the source evidence you need, and revalidate the Context Passport after edits. Otherwise use ordinary source tools. Do not claim token or cost savings.
methodology.repositories: Two synthetic multi-module Python/TypeScript maintenance fixtures; external hidden oracles
methodology.settings: Same model, effort, output schema, sandbox and tool instructions; only Memglide MCP availability differs
methodology.timing: wall_time_seconds measures Codex process; B index timing is separate and included in end_to_end_wall_seconds. Independent readiness probes are excluded

overhead.method: /proc sampling; CPU observed lower bound, RSS shared pages can be counted multiple times; short-lived processes may be missed
overhead.scope: Local Codex process tree only; remote model CPU and memory unavailable

preflight_runs.scope: Readiness request, excluded from task comparisons; usage retained separately

telemetry.file_read_method: Heuristic command-intent proxy from successful command_execution items containing literal cat, sed -n, head, tail, or rg commands with explicit file-like paths. Shell expansion, scripts, directory searches, MCP reads, and internal reads are excluded. A repeated command names a path recognized in an earlier command. This is not an I/O trace, an actual read count, or a guaranteed lower bound on filesystem reads.
telemetry.mcp_count_scope: Observed unique invocation items; total only for complete parsed streams, otherwise a lower bound
telemetry.model_calls_unavailable_reason: Codex exec JSONL exposes completed turns, not underlying provider/API model calls
telemetry.repeated_file_reads_unavailable_reason: Codex JSONL does not expose a filesystem I/O trace; command text cannot establish actual reads

telemetry.usage_scope: Complete parsed stream only; partial observed turn usage is stored separately

In this Python Atlas document-service repository, Fix cache expiration at the TTL boundary. A document cached at time 100 with TTL 10 must be unavailable at time 110 and afterwards, and expired entries must be removed. Before the deadline, return its value without changing its expiration; overwriting a key starts the new TTL. Verify the DocumentService cache path as well.

Implement the change in the production source. Use the existing offline smoke tests and add focused regression tests if useful. Do not inspect or modify benchmark machinery, grading files, or files outside this repository. Do not change the dependency or build configuration. Finish with a brief description and the tests you ran.

In this Python Atlas document-service repository, Fix the bounded document cache so it evicts the least recently used live key. A successful get must refresh recency without extending its TTL. Updating a key also makes it most recent, cache misses must not evict anything, and the capacity bound must hold. Preserve the existing API and expiration behavior.

Implement the change in the production source. Use the existing offline smoke tests and add focused regression tests if useful. Do not inspect or modify benchmark machinery, grading files, or files outside this repository. Do not change the dependency or build configuration. Finish with a brief description and the tests you ran.

In this Python Atlas document-service repository, Fix cursor pagination so traversing every page emits each document exactly once in ascending ID order. A cursor is the last emitted ID, so the next page contains strictly greater IDs even when that cursor was deleted. Keep the existing limit validation, do not mutate input records, and return a null next_cursor after the final page. Verify DocumentService integration.

Implement the change in the production source. Use the existing offline smoke tests and add focused regression tests if useful. Do not inspect or modify benchmark machinery, grading files, or files outside this repository. Do not change the dependency or build configuration. Finish with a brief description and the tests you ran.

In this Python Atlas document-service repository, Fix optimistic document updates. An update may succeed only when expected_revision exactly equals the current revision. Stale and future revisions must raise ConflictError without modifying the stored document. A successful update increments the revision once and still isolates returned bodies from caller mutation.

Implement the change in the production source. Use the existing offline smoke tests and add focused regression tests if useful. In this Python Atlas document-service repository, Fix authorization scope matching. Grant access only for the exact resource:action string or the exact resource:* wildcard. Empty scopes, partial action/resource strings, unrelated wildcards, and similar resource prefixes must not grant access. Preserve DocumentService's authorization API.

Implement the change in the production source. Use the existing offline smoke tests and add focused regression tests if useful. In this Python Atlas document-service repository, Fix POSIX storage-key containment. Normalize . and .. segments and allow a relative key only when its normalized path is the root itself or a descendant separated by /. Reject absolute keys and traversal into a sibling directory whose name begins with the storage root's name (for example root /srv/data and key ../database/secret). Preserve valid nested keys and the storage service API. No filesystem or symlink support is required.

Implement the change in the production source. Use the existing offline smoke tests and add focused regression tests if useful. Do not inspect or modify benchmark machinery, grading files, or files outside this repository. Do not change the dependency or build configuration. Finish with a brief description and the tests you ran.

Exclude the starting document, handle cycles and self-edges without looping, and treat missing graph entries as leaves. Preserve DocumentService integration and leave the caller's graph unchanged.

Implement the change in the production source. Use the existing offline smoke tests and add focused regression tests if useful. Do not inspect or modify benchmark machinery, grading files, or files outside this repository. Do not change the dependency or build configuration. In this Python Atlas document-service repository, Fix prorated billing to round the nonnegative rational cent amount half up rather than truncate. Keep all current integer and period validation, charge exactly the monthly amount for a full period, and return zero for no active days. Avoid binary floating-point rounding errors; TypeScript must support safe-integer inputs whenever the rounded result is safe, even if intermediate products exceed Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER.

Stored payloads and returned events must remain isolated from caller mutation.
